in_sanskrit.name: सङ्गवि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Sangvi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'सङ्ग' (sang), which means 'association', 'company', 'community', or 'friend'. The suffix 'वि' (vi) is added to form a masculine name, and it means 'he who is'. Thus, Sangvi can be interpreted as 'he who is friendly' or 'he who is a companion'.
